visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side lists of short dated items inside a centred white elevated card
visualCharacteristics.summary: Centred white card (about 970px wide, light border, soft drop shadow) with two columns split by a 1px #535353 vertical rule; each item has a short red-to-purple gradient dash, the date on one line and the bold item name below. Columns stack with a horizontal rule on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: one row, one rich-text cell per column; each paragraph is one item: date, line break, bold name
contentPattern.source: get_block_details /block-collection/columns and blocks/columns/_columns.json (columns=2, rows=1; column filter allows text)

cells:
Column 1 rich text: paragraphs like "Thursday, January 1
New Year's Day"
Column 2 rich text: paragraphs in the same pattern

usage: Bank Holidays calendar: dated holiday list split into two columns.
reuseGuidance: Use for short dated or labelled lists shown side by side in a card. Paragraphs or bulleted list items both work. For image/text columns use the base columns block.
